merged_situations.situation: After scanning, the app asks the server gate; if a side is still missing or the gate still withholds codes (birth date, 18+, licence validity / group) it says so honestly instead of "uploaded and verified".

guards.situation: If the gate does not answer, completeness falls back to the sides of this scan (ID front+back, passport one side, licence front+back); a skipped required side gives the "incomplete" warning.
The scanner calls verify_customer_docs at the end, but its result (name/DOB/licence mismatches) is ignored and errors are swallowed; the customer is never told about a mismatch here.
